79    public static function ssn()
80    {
81        $area = Miscellaneous::boolean() ? self::numberBetween(1, 665) : self::numberBetween(667, 899);
82        $group = self::numberBetween(1, 99);
83        $serial = self::numberBetween(1, 9999);
84
85        return sprintf('%03d-%02d-%04d', $area, $group, $serial);
